Profile.name: Geunyeong Ji
Profile.title: Solving complex problems with simple and robust code.
Profile.description: Hello! I am a full-stack developer passionate about user experience (UX) optimization and stable infrastructure design. Rather than settling for just making functional features, I strive to understand the internal mechanics of frameworks and think deeply about architectures that maximize business value. I share refined insights and newly acquired knowledge through this tech blog.
